preamble: Backing of the alveolar trill [r] to the voiced velar fricative [ɣ]. It is documented in the Palaungic and Pakanic branches of Austroasiatic: Hsiu reconstructs Proto-Pakanic *ɣ- from Pre-Pakanic *r-, noting that *r- frequently becomes /ɣ-/ in Austroasiatic, and in the Angkuic language Hu reflexes of Proto-Palaungic *r- begin with [ɣ] where other Palaungic languages such as U keep [r].

examples.note: Compare U rip⁵⁵, which keeps the trill.

sources: Hsiu, A. (2016). A preliminary reconstruction of Proto-Pakanic. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.1127812
Hsiu, A. (2017). The Angkuic languages: a preliminary survey (with comparative wordlist). Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.1127808
